about: Pressing Play on a bot's audio attachment with Enter. Staged: the fake engine cannot attach files, so the app's own MessageAttachmentGallery is mounted under Pepper's reply from the page, and the page's fetch answers the message-file request with two seconds of silent WAV. The Play button is focused from the page, then Enter is a real key press. The dashed line under the player is drawn by the capture, from document.activeElement after the key press; it is not part of the app.

steps.eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-staged-audio] button'); b.focus(); return document.activeElement === b; })()
